entries.title: A long chat on a custom model is no longer refused too early
entries.body: Infinitary no longer guesses before sending whether a chat fits a custom model. Its guess was too strict, so it refused chats and pastes the model could take. Now the model's server decides. When the server says the chat is too long, Infinitary shortens the chat and tries once more. Before sending, Infinitary now stops only a request larger than the connection can carry, and shortens the chat for that too.
entries.noPicture: Nothing new on screen: a chat that fits is now sent instead of refused.
